name: Continental Seeds and Chemicals Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1983, Continental Seeds & Chemicals Ltd is in the sale, purchase and cultivation of wheat, paddy, cereals, mentha oil and seeds of all kind[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is in the business of developing, processing, grading and supplying of all kind
of agricultural foundation and certified seeds 
and trading of Mentha Oil. It is is registered 
with Uttrakhand Seeds certification agency

pros: Stock is trading at 0.83 times its book value
Promoter holding has increased by 1.51% over last quarter.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 0.69% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -4.39% over last 3 years.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -12.2%
